ttea.service

Service classes of the T-TEA platform.

Developed by the Larva UDESC team.

This package provides the service layer (business rules) used by the controllers of the T-TEA platform.

Attributes

__version__str

The current version of the package.

__date__str

The release date of this version.

__author__str

The development team.

__license__str

The license under which the package is distributed.

CalibrationService

Screens, cameras and calibration data.

CalibrationSettingService

Calibration settings (MediaPipe, OpenCV, filters…).

HelpService

Compiled help files, languages and topics.

HelpUnavailableError

Raised when the help cannot be opened.

InstitutionFacilityService

Business rules of institutions/facilities.

LanguageService

Language detection, persistence and translators.

MainService

Global actions of the main window.

PlayerGameLaunchService

Data of the game launch screen.

PlayerService

Business rules of players.

ProfessionalService

Business rules of professionals.

Notes

This package is maintained by the Larva UDESC team and is under active development. Contributions and bug reports are welcome at: https://github.com/larvattea/ttea

Modules

calibrationservice

Calibration service: screens, cameras and calibration data.

calibrationsettingservice

Access to the calibration settings (MediaPipe, OpenCV, filters...).

helpservice

Help service: help files, languages and topics.

institutionfacilityservice

Institution/facility service: business rules and persistence.

languageservice

Language service: detection, persistence and Qt translators.

mainservice

Global service of the main window (exit and other global actions).

playergamelaunchservice

Service of the game launch screen: players, professionals, games.

playerservice

Player service: business rules and persistence of players.

professionalservice

Professional service: business rules and persistence.
